accounts.recurring_themes: Pfizer - Commercial LSC - EMEA's support activity centers on Life Sciences functionality. The dominant pattern is Deployment/environment, suggesting an architectural gap in platform configuration or customization approach. With 75 active case(s), recurring issues indicate foundational decisions requiring architectural attention.
accounts.technical_analysis: Primary technical concentration is Deployment/environment (2 instance(s)), indicating architecture-level patterns that repeatedly surface as support escalations. Secondary pattern of SOQL/query performance compounds the primary concern, indicating need for a holistic review covering data model, integration design, and customization strategy. An Architecture Design Review would establish guardrails, identify anti-patterns, and provide a roadmap to reduce ongoing support case volume.
accounts.reasoning: Account has 161 support case(s) with no ADR on record. Multiple cases indicate architectural gaps requiring review.
